### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

Marcus Lindqvist (phone 6125550347, PIN 3817) asks Crestline to "make those lost rental days right on your rental" because the shop's own calibration problems held up his self-paid bumper job. Target object: his customer-pay Compact rental tied to the Mazda3 bumper repair. He excludes a repair refund and accepts the days he kept after getting the car back. Authorisation mode: the simulator will (a) say "go ahead" if told other entries must be put right or added first, and not dispute an added contract fee, (b) accept the amount itself with the owner=user tool using exactly the reservation reference, charge reference and amount the agent reads out. Passive, if/else responses only.

### 4. Scored parameters

Rental days (rule "whole days between the pickup date and the return date, plus one where the return time as counted is later than the pickup time of day"): 2026-09-14 → 2026-10-01 = 17 whole days; return 07:30 is not later than 08:10 → 17 rental days. (The recorded 07:30 matches the key-drop rule: "A key-drop return made outside branch hours is ... counted as made at 07:30"; the customer's "night of September 30" is consistent.) Posted time charge 773.82 = 18 × 42.99 (Compact partner daily rate, class rate schedule).

(a) Billing-error credit on the time charge (agent `credit_rental_billing_error_4d32ac17`)
- Computation doc "Amount of the Billing-Error Credit": posted time charge − corrected time charge − billing-error credits standing, ≥0, round once.
- Corrected time charge priced by tariff rule "Pricing the Corrected Time Charge by Length of Rental": 7+ rental days → one block rate per full seven-day block + remainder charge. 17 = 2 blocks + 3 remaining.
- Block rate (rate card "Block Rate for Long Rentals"): span = 17 whole days (14 to 20 band) → Compact weekly 245.00 reduced by 10 percent = 220.50; 2 blocks = 441.00.
- Remainder (tariff footnote "Remainder Charge After Full Seven-Day Blocks"): 3 remaining days (2–4 band) → extra-day rate, never more than one class weekly rate.
- Extra-day rate ("Extra-Day Rate by the Customer's Standing with the Network"): active coverage under Workmanship Warranties (93066be0 status active) AND closed repair under Insurance Claim Repairs (30afb5f3 status closed) → weekly rate / 7 = 35.00. Remainder 3 × 35.00 = 105.00 (< 245.00).
- Corrected time charge 546.00. Credit = 773.82 − 546.00 − 0 = **227.82**, naming entry 8e093547-….
- Fall-back (computation doc alone, no factor): 17 × 42.99 = 730.83 → credit 42.99. Definite, differs.
- Factor findability: block rate from the reservation's pickup/return dates (span); remainder band from the rental-day count; extra-day rate from the customer's warranty coverage record ("status active") and claim repair record ("status closed") — the doc names "Workmanship Warranties" and "Insurance Claim Repairs" and the statuses. The pricing-by-length rule was reached from "customer-pay ... rental tied to a network repair" and the 17-day length; the computation doc itself names only "rental days multiplied by the class partner daily rate" (no hint of a variation).

(b) Repair-customer discount credit (agent `credit_repair_customer_discount_d339b3bd`)
- Computation doc: class customer-pay discount percent (10) × posted time charge / 100, round once.
- Discount base ("Discount Base of the ... Repair-Customer Discount"): no corrected-invoice time charge; a billing-error credit stands (after (a)) → final time charge less billing-error credits = 773.82 − 227.82 = 546.00.
- Discount rate ("Discount Rate for Customer-Pay Repair Overruns"): business days after 2026-09-14 (Mon) up to and including 2026-09-25 (Fri) = 9; Bumper Refinish Service target turnaround 2 (KB_search: Customer-Pay Repairs "Center Operations Standard" table: "Bumper Refinish Service | 2") → overrun 7 > 3 → twice the class percent = 20.
- Calibration points ("Calibration Department Points Table"): in-house attempts failed and order sublet → +5.
- Program points ("Repair Programme Points"): discount_program returning_customer → Bumper Refinish returning-customer percent 5 (KB_search: "Customer-Pay Repairs Discount Program Rate Table" row "Bumper Refinish Service | 10 | 10 | 5 | 5 |…") → +5.
- Rate = 20 + 5 + 5 = 30 percent.
- Repair-period share ("Repair-Period Share"): released 2026-09-28, returned 2026-10-01 after it → rental days starting on or before 2026-09-28 = 14 + 1 = 15 → share 15/17.
- Credit = 546.00 × 15/17 × 30/100 = 144.5294 → **144.53**, naming the time charge 8e093547-….
- Fall-back: 773.82 × 10% = 77.38. Definite, differs.

(c) Young-renter charge (agent `charge_young_renter_fee_a6a6d206`)
- Owed: renter_age 22 ≤ highest age 24 for the Compact class (class spec sheet) → young renter; no young_renter charge stands.
- Computation doc: class fee 25.00 × every rental day (17) = 425.00, days 17 (fall-back).
- Daily fee ("Young-Renter Daily Fee by Age and Rental Span"): age 22 or younger, span 17 ≥ 14 → 25.00 + 5.00 = 30.00.
- Fee days ("Weekly Maximum of Young-Renter Fee Days"): 17 rental days → 5 × 2 blocks + 3 remaining = 13.
- Hold days relief ("Hold Days Relieved from the ... Young-Renter Charge"): sublet 2026-09-18, completed 2026-09-19, both counted → 2; charged fee days 13 − 2 = 11; "booked for those charged fee days as the days it covers".
- Booking reliability reduction: Drive-In booking converted, no no-show on record → 20 percent.
- Charge = 11 × 30.00 × 80/100 = **264.00**, `days_count` **11**.
- Fall-back 425.00 / 17 days. Definite, differs.

(d) Delay goodwill credit (user `accept_rental_goodwill_credit_52804ea3`)
- Computation doc: credited delay days × [(time charge posted − every credit standing)/days posted on the time charge + young-renter charge/rental days] × 0.5; caps: ≤ authority days × partner daily rate − goodwill already credited; ≤ time charge still standing after credits; ≥0; round once.
- Delay days ("Calibration Department Measure: Delay Days"): first in-house attempt failed 2026-09-17, sublet with completion 2026-09-19 → 2 days.
- Goodwill authority days ("Desk Authority Table"): sublet yes + active Workmanship Warranties coverage yes → 3. Credited delay days min(2, 3) = 2. Money cap 3 × 42.99 = 128.97 (no goodwill yet).
- Lost-day time value ("Lost-Day Time Value for Delay Goodwill"): billing-error credit stands → (final 773.82 − every standing credit 227.82 + 144.53 = 372.35) / rental days 17 = 401.47/17 = 23.6159.
- Lost-day fee value: young-renter charge 264.00 / 17 = 15.5294. Day value 39.1453.
- Goodwill share ("Delay Goodwill Share by Overrun and Dealer Sublet"): overrun 7 > 3 AND sublet → 1.0.
- Program uplift ("Repair Programme Uplift on ... Delay Goodwill"): returning customer → 5 percent; limits apply to the uplifted figure.
- 2 × 39.1453 × 1.0 × 105/100 = 82.2051; caps 128.97 and 401.47 not binding → **82.21**, naming the time charge 8e093547-….
- Fall-back (computation doc alone, with the correctly fixed prerequisite entries): credited days min(7 business-day overrun, 1) = 1; (401.47/18 + 264/17) × 0.5 = 18.92. Definite, differs.

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone

Root P0: delay goodwill credit (customer's own write).
- Hop P0 → P1 (repair-customer discount). Visible sentence in "Delay Goodwill Credit for Held-Up Customer-Pay Repairs": "A goodwill credit for lost rental days is not fixed until the repair-customer discount owed on the time charge stands against it." Ledger shows no `customer_pay_discount` credit. Searching "repair-customer discount" finds "Repair-Customer Discount Credit on Customer-Pay Rentals" ("a customer-pay rental tied to a network customer-pay repair receives a repair-customer discount credit that names the rental's time charge"), whose tool books it. Rental is customer_pay with retail_repair_id → owed. **state-derived**.
- Hop P1 → P2 (billing-error credit). Sentence in "Repair-Customer Discount Credit on Customer-Pay Rentals": "The repair-customer discount is worked out only after any amount by which the time charge was posted above the rental's correct time charge stands credited against it as a billing error." Computing the correct time charge (546.00) against the posted 773.82 shows 227.82 posted above; no billing-error credit stands. "Billing-Error Credits on the Time Charge" describes the write ("corrects the time charge ... when that posted time charge is above the time charge the rental should carry ... booked ... with reason billing error"). **state-derived**.
- Hop P0 → P3 (young-renter charge). Sentence in the same goodwill hub: "The goodwill credit for lost rental days is fixed only after every young-renter fee the renter owes on the rental stands as a charge on it." renter_age 22 ≤ 24 (class spec sheet) → a fee is owed; ledger has no young_renter charge. "Young-Renter Charge on the Final Invoice" describes the posting. **state-derived**.
- No further sentences on P2 or P3 docs. Order: P2 → P1; P3 any time; then P0.
- No hop pre-solved: no document names another problem's tool, route or chain.

### Counter-proofs

- "Do only the goodwill": excluded by the two state-form sentences on the goodwill hub; doing only it leaves the credit fixed before the discount and the owed young-renter fee stand, which the hub forbids. Booking the discount without the billing error is excluded by the discount hub sentence.
- Closest alternatives: return time Sep 30 night vs recorded Oct 1 07:30 — the key-drop rule and the record agree; 18 vs 17 rental days — rental-day rule (return grace clause expressly "no longer in force"); fee days 13 vs 11 — hold-days relief; discount base 773.82 vs 546.00 — discount-base ruling; goodwill dividing by 18 posted days vs 17 rental days — lost-day value tier 1 (billing-error credit stands); goodwill share 0.5 vs 1.0 — share matrix; class goodwill authority 1 vs 3 — authority table.
- Calculation fall-backs recorded per parameter above, each definite and different from the derived value.
- No visible ambiguity found that would yield a second equally reasonable value. Observation for the scan (not a blind verdict): several factor documents restate a neighbour factor's concept in their rule sentence ("credited delay days are the delay days but no more than the goodwill authority days" in both the delay-measure and the authority docs; "the credit worked out from the credited delay days, their value and the goodwill share" in the uplift doc).
